Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your quotation; your comprehensive product range is a sound basis for consolidating our fastener kit. Our opening packages reflect our analysis of the additional business we could place with you.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Consolidating the full kit under a longer commitment would give you more predictable repeat demand, with the expanded award conditional on a practical delivery-recovery plan. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining your quoted terms; which package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.14 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We value our relationship and look forward to building on it through this broader package.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your proposal to consolidate the fastener kit and your commitment to a 24-month agreement.
We have reviewed the verified increase in your demand forecast and adjusted our calculation accordingly.
For a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for revising your price to reflect the verified demand growth and proposed consolidation. Your request for binding volume is reasonable; we are making a modest price step in recognition of your movement and ask for a further step from you.

We are flexible on payment terms, with an option retaining your requested standard terms; which works best for you? Consolidating the full kit under a longer commitment supports predictable repeat demand, with the expanded award conditional on a practical delivery-recovery plan. We can commit to over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.30 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.23 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.25 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive approach—let’s get the nuts and bolts of this package right together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your commitment to a 24-month agreement.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. In response to your movement, we are prepared to make a further concession to €5.44 per unit for the 30-day payment term. As an alternative to this, we can present an alternative package at a price of €5.44 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our offer stands at a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

To help us finalize this calculation, could you please specify the exact volume you intend to commit to under this consolidated package? Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
